### Props

| Name       | Type                                                                     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `repo`     | `string`                                                                 |          | `''`    | `<owner>/<repo>` of the app's GitHub repository. When omitted, falls back to the loadState value, then to `ConductionNL/<appId>`.                                   |
| `features` | `Array<{slug: string, title: string, summary: string, docsUrl: string}>` |          | `null`  | Build-time feature manifest. When omitted, falls back to the loadState value, then to an empty array.                                                               |
| `disabled` | `union`                                                                  |          | `null`  | Admin opt-out flag. When omitted, falls back to the loadState value, then to false.                                                                                 |
| `appId`    | `string`                                                                 |          | `''`    | Override for the appId used to namespace loadState lookups. Tests pass an explicit value; production reads it from the `cnAiContext` inject populated by CnAppRoot. |
